text:
Carmen: Heads-up — multiple customers reporting 5xx + timeouts on hosted endpoints since ~08:45 UTC. p95 tail timeouts and gateway 502/504s. Ingress queue depth at ~98% on several hosts, continuous-batcher backlog climbing. Raising incident.

Raj: On it. Can you paste sample request IDs / tenant IDs and model route? Any commonalities?

Carmen: Tenants: tenant-acme, tenant-blox. Model route: /v1/generate using gpt-small-quant v2. Sample curl from support below.

Jordyn: Repro from customer: repeated ~200 short requests in ~1s burst. Curl:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Auth checks out but UI shows 504s and 5xx spikes.

Emma: Looking at metrics — ingress-proxy queue_depth and batcher.queue_length spiked. batcher_dequeue_latency and gateway.forward_errors increased. Quick mitigation options: reduce continuous_batcher.max_await to 10ms, enable early_queue_reject for non-SLA tenants, or spin up +2 workers if autoscale didn't trigger.

Raj: Need traces and logs for the batcher and gateway. Post any sample lines you have (batcher enqueue/dequeue, kv cache hits/misses, upstream timeouts).

Carmen: Pasted relevant log snippets:
```
[2026-03-17T08:44:30Z] batcher: enqueue size=312 shard=3
[2026-03-17T08:44:31Z] batcher: dequeue size=0 reason=deferred_kv_miss
[2026-03-17T08:44:33Z] gateway: forward error=upstream_timeout code=504 req=abc123
[2026-03-17T08:44:34Z] kvcache: hit_rate=12% tenant=tenant-acme
[2026-03-17T08:44:35Z] rate_limiter: 429 -> retry req=abc124
```

Carmen: Notably kv cache hit-rate dropped from ~72% -> 12% at spike start. Looks like a cache coldstart + tenant burst. Also seeing retry amplification (clients retrying on 429/504).

Jordyn: Are shared-plan rate-limits configured correctly? Should have early shedding before hitting batcher tail. Customers say they sent short requests repeatedly; we should enforce tenant-level early_reject.

Emma: Found config drift on one ingress host: `ingress.max_queue_depth` was accidentally set to 5000 instead of 500. That host didn't shed and allowed the batcher backlog to snowball. Pushing rollback to 500 now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: rollback config ingress.max_queue_depth -> 500 on pool ingress-prod-eu (change-id: cfg-2026-03-17-089).

Carmen: After rollback queue depth is dropping. p95 latency improved from ~13s -> ~1.6s on affected hosts. Still seeing residual 5xx from in-flight batches, but degradation is clearing.

Raj: Follow-ups: add a small circuit-breaker on continuous_batcher to early-reject when dequeue rate is zero for N seconds; add kv-cache prewarm on scale events; add a smoke test for ingress.max_queue_depth to CI.

Jordyn: I'll notify affected customers, open support tickets, and mark incident as active. Will include repro steps and ask customers to back off retries temporarily. :thumbsup:

Carmen: Thanks all. Action items: rollback verified, targeted tenant-level early_reject to be rolled out, CI test to prevent config drift, add postmortem if customer impact > 1h. Tagging SRE/infra for deeper RCA.
